description: This file implements a compile-time profiler for PyTorch, including URL generation, profiling control, and logging functionalities.

classes.name: StrobelightCompileTimeProfiler
classes.description: A class managing compile-time profiling, including enabling profiling, generating URLs, and logging statistics.

methods.name: get_frame
methods.description: Retrieves the current trace ID from the CompileContext.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables the profiling, initializing the profiler with specified parameters.

methods.name: _cls_init
methods.description: Initializes unique identifiers and logs for the profiling session.

methods.name: _log_stats
methods.description: Logs the success and failure counts of profiling runs.

methods.name: profile_compile_time
methods.description: Profiles a given function during a specific phase, with support for filtering and recursion handling.
